about_the_game:
Game Introduction

"Xialuo: Kill All Flowers" is a meticulously crafted single-player wuxia RPG developed by Xialuo Studio. It innovatively combines "board game dice mechanics," "Cthulhu-esque mystery elements," and an "open dynamic world," offering a fresh turn-based adventure experience! Step into this dark and mysterious wuxia world, where you'll unravel strange and bizarre phenomena, while encountering and befriending various unique heroes who practice the "Way of the Xia" in their own ways. Together, you'll chase after the "truth" of this world.

Skills System

  • A thousand combinations of skills are hidden within martial arts. The eighteen martial arts can be freely unleashed, with hundreds of martial arts skills waiting for you to collect!

  • Players can gather and combine skills in various ways to create different playstyles and tactics. With thousands of possible combinations, every unique fighting style you craft could become the unbeatable, world-shaking technique of the Jianghu!

Inner Strength and Mental Techniques

  • From the orthodox internal martial arts of renowned sects to the unique mental techniques of reclusive masters, you can freely collect and combine them as you wish.

Divine Weapons and Rare Treasures

  • The divine weapons and rare treasures scattered throughout the Jianghu, some lying dormant in hidden valleys or secret realms, others passing through the hands of both righteous and evil individuals. Each of these items holds the power to alter your destiny: obtaining one could greatly enhance your martial abilities and help you win battles, but possessing one might also drag you into fierce treasure hunts or bring you into dangerous conflicts. This fate and misfortune often hinge on a single thought.

Main Storyline

  • As love, hate, and personal vendettas unfold layer by layer within the Jianghu tapestry, and the boundaries between righteousness and evil grow increasingly blurred... every step you take writes your own unique final chapter in the Jianghu. Meanwhile, the paths you did not choose will eventually become the lingering echoes in the legendary tales of the Jianghu.

Jianghu Factions

  • Righteous and evil sects stand in equal opposition, engaging in both open and covert struggles, forming alliances and breaking them. The prestigious sects value sincerity in their dealings, while the chaotic underworld factions require careful maneuvering and diplomacy. Every interaction with these factions, every decision regarding your stance, paves the way for your ascent to the peak of the Jianghu.

The Joy of Love and Hate

  • From a nobody to a legendary hero of the Jianghu, every swing of the sword hides a choice of the righteous: Will you draw your blade in passionate justice for the wronged, or will you press forward with solitary courage, holding steadfast to your principles? Every step of your heroic journey reshapes the very fabric of the Jianghu, ultimately crafting a legend that is uniquely yours.

Beautiful Companion

  • She may be as lively and playful as a bird in the forest, as cold and proud as a plum in the snow, as graceful as the misty rains of the South, or as bold and swift as the northern winds and blades. Together, you ride through the Jianghu side by side, unlocking a unique story of your own, adding a touch of gentle warmth amidst the flashing blades and swords.

Strange Encounters and Fortuitous Opportunities

  • Hidden mysteries lie within the streets and alleys, and every encounter in the Jianghu is a chance meeting of fate: it could be a long-lost secret manual hidden in a cliffside cave, a casual piece of advice from a drunken beggar, or an unexpected bond formed with a wandering hero. Each unanticipated meeting may hold the key to changing your destiny, making the path through the Jianghu full of unknown surprises.
